column3: “the leaders of Shechem” renders “the lords (citizens) of Shechem” (also in verses 3, 39, 46–47, 51); “in the hearing of” renders “in the ears of.”
“relatives” renders “brothers”; “they were inclined to follow” renders “their heart turned after.”
NASB supplies “pieces of”; “worthless and reckless fellows” renders “unprincipled and undisciplined men.”
“the men of Shechem” renders “the citizens of Shechem” (also in verses 7, 18, 20, 23–25); “the oak of the pillar” renders “the great tree of the pillar.”
“Once the trees went forth” renders the doubled verb “the trees surely went.”
“God and men” renders “elohim and men,” which may also mean “gods and men”; “wave” renders “sway.”
“God and men” renders “elohim and men,” which may also mean “gods and men”; “cheers” renders “makes glad.”
“as he deserved” renders “according to the dealing of his hands.”
“risked his life” renders “threw his life in front.”
NASB supplies “done to” and “might be laid.”
“set men in ambush against him” renders “set ambushers for him.”
“Would, therefore, that” renders the Hebrew wish “Who will give”; “under my authority” renders “in my hand,” and “said to Abimelech” renders “said of Abimelech.”
